title: Is every contact ending well?
subtitle: Per-contact resolution quality across voice, chat, email and ticket — sentiment exit, FCR, repeats, premature closure and tone drift.
persona: Head of CX — HDFC Credit Cards
_note: Topics/categories/intents are the REAL themes mined from HDFC X (@HDFCBank_Cares complaints) + Reddit (r/CreditCardsIndia). All metric VALUES are mock for the demo (no internal contact-center data). Numbers are one coherent snapshot for the active window; scale down for 24h / up for 30d.

contact_health_score.label: Contact Health Score
contact_health_score.verdict: Contact-quality eroding for the 11th week. Post-contact CSAT and Tone Drift are the lead drag.

insights.title: Per-contact resolution is breaking on Ticket + Chat
insights.body: Ticket Repeat 27% / Premature 11% and Chat Tone-Drift 22% are the worst cells in the quality matrix. These two channels alone account for ~60% of poor-ending contacts.

insights.title: Fee disputes and card servicing drive half of all repeats
insights.body: 412 fee-dispute + 248 card-servicing repeats this week — 49% of total. Neither has a standard waiver/servicing playbook; agents improvise, inflating AHT and repeat-contact rate.

insights.title: Tone drift concentrates on the evening shift
insights.body: 18% of evening contacts show negative tone-drift mid-conversation — 2.4x the day-shift rate, worst on recovery-collections and fraud disputes. Coaching window opens after the 6pm shift handover.

quality_matrix.title: QUALITY MATRIX · PER-CHANNEL
quality_matrix.subtitle: Five quality signals x four contact channels — green: on target, amber: watch, red: breaching
quality_matrix.hotspot: Ticket and Chat carry the worst Repeat + Premature Closure scores · Voice quality holds best.

closure_diagnostics.title: WHERE CONTACTS FAIL TO END WELL
closure_diagnostics.subtitle: Stacked by channel · click a bar to see what's broken and how to fix it

categories.issue: Re-KYC verification and account-freeze / SafePass lockout flows are creating unresolved closures.
categories.recommended_fix: Push re-KYC status + unblock request to self-service and add a closure-confirmation script before ending chat.

categories.issue: Unauthorized-transaction and UPI-failure disputes reopen when evidence collection and reversal SLAs slip.
categories.recommended_fix: Auto-attach the dispute evidence checklist and commit a reversal-SLA date on the first contact.

categories.issue: Card block/activation, downgrade and delivery-status requests loop between app, RM and phone-banking.
categories.recommended_fix: Expose card block/unblock + downgrade in-app and close the RM/phone-banking handoff loop.

categories.issue: Late-fee, AMB and finance-charge waivers have no standard playbook; agents improvise responses.
categories.recommended_fix: Ship a fee-waiver decision playbook plus a plain-language charge-explanation article.

categories.issue: Recovery-agent and unsolicited-loan-call complaints escalate when opt-out / DND requests aren't honoured.
categories.recommended_fix: Suppress from calling lists on first request and route harassment claims to a grievance queue with an SLA.

categories.issue: CDM/ATM out-of-service and branch-service gaps push customers back to digital channels unresolved.
categories.recommended_fix: Surface real-time ATM/CDM status and fast-track branch issues to regional ops.
